purpose.description: Your TypeMart project aims to implement a type-safe purchase flow: import products, select a product by name, compute shipping, tax, and total, and print a receipt. The code largely follows the tasks and runs without syntax errors for the chosen path.
Nice use of a concrete product selection (productName) and console.log to verify the found product. The flow aligns with the task sequence for price/tax/shipping calculations.

readability.description: Code is readable with straightforward variable names and a linear flow.
Use consistent types and convert string prices to numbers when needed; some values like price and preOrder are strings in your data which can cause confusion later.
Add comments to separate tasks (selection, shipping, tax, total) for easier navigation.

performance.description: Basic arithmetic and console usage are fine for this task sequence.
Consider using proper types for product data (price as number, preOrder as boolean) to reduce repeated conversions and guard against invalid data.
Avoid duplicating logic: once you extract product, compute shipping/tax/total in dedicated small functions to improve maintainability and testability.
